en: The front of the postcard features large letters forming the words 'HÄLSNING från SUNDSVALL,' with each letter filled with small photographic images of various city scenes, buildings, and landscapes from Sundsvall. There is a decorative crescent moon and stars motif. The back of the postcard contains handwritten text in Swedish, a Swedish postage stamp, and typical postcard address fields.
